name: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
description: Five years after the death of schoolgirl Andie Bell, Pippa Fitz-Amobi sets out to uncover what really happened to her. Sal Singh, Andie's boyfriend, admitted to the murder before taking his own life, but Pip doesn't believe he's responsible and teams up with Sal's brother Ravi to uncover the truth. If Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pip from finding out the truth?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Teenager Pip Fitz-Amobi investigates the disappearance of Andie Bell, who was supposedly murdered by her boyfriend Sal Singh five years ago. Pip is determined to prove otherwise.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Now a team, Pip and Ravi turn their attention to Andie's best friends and find out Andie had a secret life that Sal was unhappy about. Meanwhile, Pip receives an anonymous warning.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When Pip follows new leads on the case, she takes bigger risks and enters the world of sex, drugs and rock 'n' roll.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Pip and Ravi find out more about Andie's secret life, and when Pip is presented with a new piece of evidence, she reaches a crisis point and questions whether Sal is guilty.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pip discovers more than she bargained for and faces dark consequences when she tries to confront the killer. Just when it seems all is lost, the terrible truth is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Pip must come to terms with the repercussions of solving the case. But something isn't quite right, and Pip puts herself in danger once more to find out the whole truth.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Pip attempts to return to normal life and focus on her friends, school and Ravi. But when a key witness in Max Hastings's trial disappears, Pip feels the pull of a new case.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Pip hits a dead end and rethinks. Digging into Jamie's recent behaviour and last movements, she realises he may not be an innocent victim after all.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Pip's day in court proves harder than she imagined, while a promising lead about Jamie comes from an unlikely source.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Fresh evidence forces Pip back to her first line of inquiry with renewed urgency, while Max Hastings's testimony causes shock waves through the court.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A daring night mission causes group tension and isolates Pip. Jamie's case stalls until Pip decodes a clue that cracks it wide open. In court, the verdict is given.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As they chase the truth, Pip and her friends face new risks and shocking discoveries. Will they find Jamie and make it through unharmed?
